tutorial:
SEARCHING
1. In the search bar type the ISBN, title or the module code of the book you want to buy.
2. To contact the owner of the book click the cart icon. An email and a message will be sent to the owner notifying them that you want to buy the book.
3. If the owner of the book sells the book that you have requested to buy, an email will be sent to you to let you know.


UPLOADING
1. Take a picture of the front cover of the book you want to upload.
2. Before uploading your book make sure that you have a picture of its front cover on the device you want to upload it from.
3. Input the ISBN, module code and the asking price in the upload options. If you don't remember the module code you can leave
it blank or you can have a look at your proof of registration to see it.
4. After clicking the upload button you will see a confirmation page. After checking that all the book details are on the page
you can click the confirm book button and your book will be uploaded to the system.
5. If you want to delete or edit a book you've uploaded you can go to your book collection and see it there.


SELLING A BOOK
1. After getting a request to buy a book you can talk to the buyer on our chat system to arrange the details of the exchange (see the saftey tips).
2. When you have finalised the sale, you should go to your book collection and mark the book as sold. Please note that if you delete
the book your credibilty will not increase becasie we can't verify that it has been sold.


GETTING VERIFIED
1. In order to get verified you have to sell 15 books on the plaform or get 20 people to sign up.
2. After selling 15 books and you still don't see the verification symbolon your profile, send an email to support@qampus.co.za in order to get your account verified.

UPDATING PROFILE
1. On the home page, click on the Settings option.
2. Click on the pencil icon to change your details.
3. Click on the save icon to save your changes.
4. To change you profile image, click on the Add Image button and then crop the image.


USING NAVIGATOR EFFECIENTLY
1. Select the destinations of your choice then click the get directions button.
2. After your directions have loaded, click the 'More options' link on the result window. This will take you to a Google maps web page.
3. On the left hand side, click on the 'Send directions to your phone' link to get the derections on your Google Maps app.
4. Sign in with Google and then select the device you want to send it to.
5. After a few seconds you will get a notification on your phone with the derections.
